page_title: SEV 0-2 RSO | Sevilla v Real Sociedad 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Alejandro Ruiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

90+5' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Javi Lopez is replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
90+2' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' It's time for a substitution. Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Sergio Gomez.
87' Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
85' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
85' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
84' The attendance for today's match is 37619.
82' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Takefusa Kubo.
80' Albert Sambi Lokonga comes off the pitch to be replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) replaces Isaac Romero.
80' Here is a change. Brais Mendez is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
80' A substitution has been made. Mikel Oyarzabal is replaced by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
79' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
75' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
74' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Isra Dominguez (Sevilla) heads on.
73' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Juanlu Sanchez and he is replaced by Isra Dominguez (Sevilla).
73' The substitution is prepared. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marcao.
71' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:9.
68' 0 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alvaro Fernandez into the bottom right corner.
67' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcao (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Real Sociedad!
65' Referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Real Sociedad. Let’s see what happens!
65' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
64' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
64' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' What a long-range shot by Isaac Romero (Sevilla). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
62' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
57' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
55' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.

54' The ball is cleared after Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
49' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad).
48' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) launches a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro is alert to thwart the effort.
45+2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Isaac Romero (Sevilla) inside the box. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' It looked like the long-range shot by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
45+1' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Now Real Sociedad have a corner. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

43' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
42' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
39' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
35' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.

34' 0 - 1 Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Alvaro Fernandez is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
32' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
29' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' None of the Real Sociedad players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
25' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Real Sociedad force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) suffers an injury and Jesus Navas comes on.
24' Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
21' 36:64 – the ratio of ball possession.

18' That didn't go as planned! Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Alvaro Fernandez, who easily kept it out.
13' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

13' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Isaac Romero (Sevilla), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
11' A yellow card is awarded to Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
10' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
9' The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The free kick from close range, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
7' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
3' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
